normalize_text: normalize a string or list of tokens into a detokenized sentence using TreebankWordDetokenizer
tokenize_text: tokenize a text string into a list of word tokens using NLTK word_tokenize
randomly_delete_word: randomly delete a single word from a given text string and return the result
test_normalize_text: test the normalize_text function with a sample sentence containing punctuation and contractions
test_tokenize_text: test the tokenize_text function with a sample sentence and verify the token list output
